digest.component_or_area: reconciler backend port / vendor adapter seam
propositions: Four core modules (fetcher.py, applier.py, apply_handlers.py, _attestation.py) still import from adapters.jira directly, violating the vendor-neutral backend port contract (epic bbf1 AC3)

The Backend Protocol must expose scalar, translation-only members (project, query_project, assert_env_ready()) and neutral exception types (BackendEnvError, BackendAssigneeNotFoundError) that JiraBackend implements by delegating to resolve_jira_settings
All nested (function-level) and module-level imports of adapters.jira must be eliminated from the four modules and verified by an AST walker that uses ast.walk (not top-level-only traversal)

The applier's DIG-defaulted project guard, fetcher's fail-closed query_project behavior, _attestation's JIRA_* environment validation, and apply_handlers' assignee soft-fail semantics must be preserved after rewiring through the backend facade
